name: WalkthroughModal
intent: A large, edge-to-edge MapCompareLayout (with the session timeline) shown in a dialog with a single compact 14px title and no subtitle. Opened from a capture point or a blueprint walk-through button to compare that capture against another session.
when: Opening a full-screen capture comparison from a walk-through button or capture point
Comparing two capture sessions in a modal

chooseOver.because: WalkthroughModal is the composed capture-compare modal; Dialog is the generic modal container

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation

props.name: title
props.description: Title shown in the header, e.g. `Capture 2 of 17 · Ground Floor · 10:05`.

usage: Use WalkthroughModal when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions, confirmations, or supplementary information.
WalkthroughModal should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve this component for important interactions that require user attention or action before continuing.

anatomy.description: WalkthroughModal is composed of the following parts:

parts.name: WalkthroughModalTrigger
parts.description: Element that opens the dialog when activated.

parts.name: WalkthroughModalContent
parts.description: Container for the dialog content and overlay.

parts.name: WalkthroughModalHeader
parts.description: Header section containing title and description.

bestPractices.title: Focus management
bestPractices.description: Trap focus within the dialog and return focus when closed.

bestPractices.title: Don't nest dialogs
bestPractices.description: Avoid opening dialogs from within dialogs, use sequential flow instead.

bestPractices.title: Provide clear exit
bestPractices.description: Always include a visible close button and support Escape key.

bestPractices.title: Don't trap users
bestPractices.description: Never make dialogs impossible to close or require specific actions to dismiss.

bestPractices.title: Keep content focused
bestPractices.description: Limit dialog content to a single task or decision.

bestPractices.title: Don't overload dialogs
